'''Swamo''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] ordnance [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] who was stationed at the [[Lower Sundari Outpost|Sundari Imperial Outpost]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
